question: According to Census of India 2011, what was the total population of India (approx)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**121 Crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, the total population of India was approximately **121 Crore**.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and is one of the most comprehensive sources of demographic data in the country.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1871.
